description: This file contains utility functions for loading and managing test projects, test files, and suites in the Playwright test runner, including project collection, test file loading, suite creation, filtering, and source map handling.

classes.name: Suite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, used for organizing tests and suites.

methods.name: collectProjectsAndTestFiles
methods.description: Collects project files and sets up project suites based on configuration and filters.

methods.name: loadFileSuites
methods.description: Loads test files into suites, handling dependencies and errors.

methods.name: createRootSuite
methods.description: Creates the root suite with all project and test suite organization, including filtering, sharding, and dependencies.

methods.name: loadGlobalHook
methods.description: Loads a global hook script for the test environment.

methods.name: loadReporter
methods.description: Loads a reporter module for test reporting.
